method_caveat: Uses synchronized internal timing summaries. It estimates verifier upper bounds under perfect draft acceptance; it is not a live endpoint throughput result and not a quality proof.
notes: Endpoint-scaled estimates normalize bucket timing against the accepted non-speculative endpoint row.
Visible-timed estimates are conservative because synchronization instrumentation slows serving.
Draft accept fraction assumes expected emitted tokens = 1 + fraction * (bucket - 1).
